verdicts.title: Pause menu Resume button covered by toast
verdicts.observed: After walking to (7,6) and pressing pause, the pause menu is open but btn-resume reports top=false, so something else sits on top of it at its centre. The 'Key collected' toast is still visible at that moment.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it. The toast must not overlap the pause menu's Resume button.

verdicts.title: Spike hit at score 0 wraps score to 65036 and later goes negative
verdicts.observed: Score is 0 when the player dashes onto spikes at (1,1)-adjacent tile. The score jumps to 65036 (0 minus 500 wrapped as unsigned 16-bit), and on the next coin it shows -400. Score is never clamped at 0.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 and never goes negative; score must stay within 0..999,999.

verdicts.title: Double dash in one tick moves 3 tiles and HUD coin counter is stale
verdicts.observed: Sending dash-down+dash-down in one tick moves the player from (1,1) to (1,4), three tiles, although a dash is at most two tiles and only one move per tick is allowed. The coin is collected (state coins=1) but the HUD still shows Coins 0/5.
verdicts.expected: Only the last movement key counts, so the player moves at most one dash of two tiles (to (1,3)). The HUD must always show the current coin count.

verdicts.title: False positive: clock changes on the tick that resumes and then gets hit
verdicts.observed: At tick 77 'enter+dash-left' resumes from pause, which is a running tick, and then the dash hits the slime and ends in gameover. The clock advances while the timer stays at 239, which matches the design because the timer only drops if the game is still playing at the end of the tick.
verdicts.expected: A tick in which the game resumes is a running tick, so the clock may advance. The check should not require a frozen clock on that transition.

verdicts.title: Restart level from pause menu leaves game paused and resets timer while paused
verdicts.observed: With the game paused, click:btn-restart resets the timer to 300 and the events show restart, but mode stays 'paused' and the pause menu stays open.
verdicts.expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away, so mode should be 'playing'.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves game paused; the game then sits frozen behind the pause menu
verdicts.observed: After esc and click:btn-restart, the state resets (score 0, lives 3, time 300) but mode remains 'paused' with the pause menu still open. Waiting afterwards changes nothing until the player presses Resume.
verdicts.expected: After Restart level the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing') and the pause menu is hidden.

verdicts.title: Pausing on a tick still moves the player (rest of tick input not ignored)
verdicts.observed: Tick 0 'pause+down': the game became paused and the player still moved from (1,1) to (1,2) with a move event.
verdicts.expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player should stay at (1,1) and nothing else should happen in that tick.

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin during a dash
verdicts.observed: After 'dash-down+dash-down' the state shows coins=1 but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5', and it remains stale on the paused tick.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Spike hit makes score jump to 65136, then go negative
verdicts.observed: Stepping onto spikes at tick 6 changed score from 100 to 65136 instead of subtracting 500. A later coin then showed score -300.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points, clamped at 0, so the score should be 0 after the hit. Score must never be negative or wrap around.

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stale after dash pickup; score later goes negative
verdicts.observed: At tick 3 'dash-right' collected a coin (state coins=1) but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5'. Later the score wraps to 65136 after spikes and reaches -800 at tick 18.
verdicts.expected: The HUD should show the current coin count (1/5). Score must stay within 0..999,999, with spikes subtracting 500 clamped at 0.
